title: Engineering All-Hands - 2026-03-25
content:
Attendees: All engineering org (recording available on Confluence page).

1) Opening (Asha)
- Quick agenda: status updates, platform health, upcoming releases, hiring & org notes, Q&A.
- Shoutouts: platform infra team for keeping the Canary rollout stable during regional tests; SRE on-call rotation for triaging the multi-region failover last Friday.

2) Platform health & metrics (Connor)
- Latency: 95th P99 tail latency for hosted-api gen endpoints held at 420ms for 16k token horizon across US-West. Slight uptick on Wed due to noisy neighbors - mitigation implemented and spike resolved by rolling node restart.
- Throughput: Average tokens/sec increased by ~12% after the batching changes merged last week (see PR #1287).
- Errors: 0.3% elevated 5xx rate on Dedicated pools during a config rollout; root cause in autoscaler race condition (JIRA-ENG-4021). Patch is in canary, monitoring for regressions.
- Cost: Per-token infra cost down ~6% month-over-month due to improved kernel selection heuristics.

3) Releases & rollouts (Jia)
- Runtime v2.9 rollout: canary at 15% traffic, no regressions observed in generation fidelity tests. Plan to ramp to 50% on Mon 3/30, full rollout by Wed 4/1 if metrics hold. Linked tests: regression suite (confluence link in artifacts).
- Console: feature flagging for per-route token budgeting will go to beta next week - opt-in for 10 customers.
- Dedicated: Reserved pool autoscaling change scheduled for 2026-04-06 (maintenance window will be sent to customers).

4) Private / On-prem updates (Miguel)
- Private deployment appliance v1.2.1 released to pilot customers. Contains KMS integration and enhanced audit logging. One pilot customer reported a TLS handshake error; fix posted to pilot channel and patch in 1.2.2.
- On-prem packaging improvements reduced deployment time by ~20% in internal e2e tests.

5) Observability & troubleshooting (Rina)
- New tracing hook landed which tags requests with rollout-id and model-variant. This made debugging a noisy-variant issue trivial in last incident. Please add rollout-id to any new rollout PRs.
- Logs retention policy for console metrics will move to 90 days for pro customers; action item: update docs and pricing page (assigned to product-ops).

6) Security & compliance (brief)
- SOC2 continuous monitoring work is on schedule. Remaining items: finalize key rotation playbook and complete third-party vendor checklist.
- Reminder to complete the quarterly security training by 2026-04-05.

7) Hiring & org updates
- Platform-engineering headcount: approved for +4 IC hires this quarter focused on serving runtime and performance. Hiring leads: Connor (runtime senior), Jia (performance engineer), recruiting ramp assigned.
- New PM: welcome Laura McKenna to product-hosted-api starting 4/6.

8) OKRs check-in (Asha)
- Q1 objective: Improve unit economics for the top 10 customers. Status: on track - two of three targeted optimization workstreams merged (batching and kernel tuning). Remaining item: cache prewarm strategy (owners: runtime + optimize).

9) Oncall & reliability notes
- Oncall rotation reminder: new handoff playbook is live in Confluence. If you are oncall the week of 3/29, ensure you validate regional failover in staging.
- Pager fatigue: SRE is trialing a 2-person shadow rotation for high-severity pages for two weeks. Feedback welcome.

10) Action items (owner -> due date)
- Connor -> 2026-03-30: finish autoscaler race fix and deploy to canary (JIRA-ENG-4021).
- Jia -> 2026-03-29: prepare rollout runbook and rollback playbook for runtime v2.9.
- Miguel -> 2026-03-28: ship on-prem patch 1.2.2 to pilot customers and summarize pilot feedback.
- Rina -> 2026-04-02: update logs retention docs and pricing note; coordinate with product-ops.
- Recruiting -> 2026-04-15: post job reqs for platform-engineering roles and begin first round interviews.

11) Q&A highlights
- Q: Any ETA on per-route budget GA? A: Beta next week; GA tentatively late Q2 pending beta feedback.
- Q: How are we measuring model quality regressions during runtime rollouts? A: We run the prompt-based regression suite (linked) and correlate generation metrics with RTT and token cost; alerts trigger rollback.

12) Notes to follow-up
- Add an anonymized post-mortem for last Friday's noisy neighbor event to the SRE channel - request volunteers to draft.
- Engineering leadership to discuss longer-term capacity forecasting model in next leadership sync.

13) Closing
- Reminder: all-hands recording, slides, and detailed metric dashboards are on the shared Confluence page (see linked_artifacts). Please add follow-ups as comments on the page.

Misc (freeform notes captured during meeting):
- Quick brainstorm: margin tooling idea - a dashboard surfacing per-customer cost delta if we switch to a cheaper variant under a detected SLO window.
- FYI: internal spike on sequence-length-aware batching underway - expect preliminary results next week.
